text: I stay SUPPORT, timing WAIT. SN is LEADER on the heaviest volume in the room, day_vol 2.72 (C16 passes), group strong. But pct_from_pivot 5.09 is already past the C17 5% line, so buying above yesterday's high chases further past the pivot. The trigger I stand behind is h1_close_above:pivot_high: a pullback toward the pivot, then an hourly close back above it, never more than 5% past it (C17, C21). Dropping the pull-in buys a late entry I cannot take. reclaim:ma_20 buys an average, not the pivot. Wrong if the pullback comes on heavier volume than the breakout (C25).
